stem: According to the 2017 ILAE classification, what is the primary factor used to determine the first general division of seizure types?

options.text: The duration of the seizure activity
The initial manifestation of the seizure onset
The underlying genetic or structural etiology
The presence or absence of motor manifestations

explanation: The ILAE framework classifies seizures based on whether the very first sign is focal, generalized, or unknown.
rationale: Consider whether the seizure starts in one part of the body or involves the whole body simultaneously.

optionExplanations.A: While duration is critical for status epilepticus, the primary classification division focuses on where the seizure begins in the brain.
optionExplanations.B: The ILAE framework classifies seizures based on whether the very first sign is focal, generalized, or unknown.
optionExplanations.C: Etiology is a separate level of the overall epilepsy classification framework rather than the initial division of seizure types.
optionExplanations.D: Motor versus non-motor manifestations are sub-classifications that occur after determining the onset type.

originalCorrectOptionTexts: The initial manifestation of the seizure onset
